title: Procedure: mid-month salary change (BE)
snippet: Apply the new salary pro rata from the effective date, using calendar days. Confirm the effective date in writing before the pay run closes.

title: Procedure: mid-month salary change (BE), previous version
snippet: Apply the new salary from the first day of the next pay period. Mid-month changes are not pro-rated.

title: Procedure: mid-month salary change (NL)
snippet: Apply the new salary from the first day of the month in which the change is agreed. Document the agreement date.

title: Checklist: salary changes for mid-size clients (BE)
snippet: Before a mid-month change, check the client's pay calendar, confirm the signed amendment, and notify the client contact by the cut-off date.

title: Salary change notes
snippet: Some clients want mid-month changes handled in the following pay run. Ask the client which they prefer.

title: Teams thread: "just backdate it to the 1st"
snippet: A colleague suggests backdating mid-month salary changes to the first of the month to keep the pay run simple.

title: Client agreement: Alpine Logistics pay calendar
snippet: Restricted client-specific pay calendar and change rules for one client.

title: Procedure: retroactive correction of a closed pay run (BE)
snippet: A closed pay run may be corrected only with approval from the payroll lead. Record the reason and the affected employees.

title: Tips for retroactive corrections on closed pay runs
snippet: Small corrections (under 50 euro per employee) can go straight into the next pay run without payroll lead approval. Show the difference per employee to the client.

title: Teams thread: "corrections after close need finance approval"
snippet: A colleague states that corrections on a closed pay run need approval from the client's finance department.

title: Procedure: correction de paie rétroactive (FR)
snippet: Une paie clôturée ne peut être corrigée qu'avec l'accord du responsable paie. Consigner le motif et les salariés concernés.

title: Retroactive corrections: client communication template (FR)
snippet: Modèle de message pour informer le client d'une correction rétroactive et des montants concernés.

title: Sick leave reporting deadlines (BE)
snippet: Report an employee's sick leave to the payroll team by the end of the next working day.

title: Arrêt maladie: délais de déclaration (FR)
snippet: Déclarer l'arrêt maladie de l'employé à l'équipe paie dans les deux jours ouvrés.

title: Teams thread: "sick leave deadline is two days"
snippet: A colleague states that sick leave must be reported within two days.

title: Edge cases: part-time employees on sick leave (BE)
snippet: For part-time employees, report sick leave the same way but attach the current contract schedule.

title: Cross-border employee payroll checklist (BE side)
snippet: For employees living in the Netherlands and working in Belgium, confirm the tax residence document and agree which country's rules apply to each pay element.

title: Cross-border employee payroll checklist (NL side)
snippet: For employees working in the Netherlands and living in Belgium, confirm the residence document and agree which country's rules apply to each pay element.

title: Who to ask about cross-border cases
snippet: Route cross-border questions to the cross-border payroll team with the client name, both countries, and the pay element in question.

title: Client portfolio handover checklist
snippet: When you inherit a portfolio, list each client's countries, special agreements, open issues, and the named contacts, then confirm them with the previous consultant or team lead.

title: Handover notes: Alpine Logistics
snippet: Restricted handover notes for one client account.

title: Teams thread: "handover is one doc and a call"
snippet: A colleague describes handovers as one document and a one-hour call with the previous consultant.

title: Year-end payroll closing calendar (BE)
snippet: Year-end cut-off dates for pay runs, corrections, and client confirmations in Belgium.

title: Year-end payroll closing calendar (FR)
snippet: Year-end cut-off dates for pay runs, corrections, and client confirmations in France.

title: Year-end closing for enterprise clients (BE)
snippet: Additional year-end steps for enterprise clients with several legal entities in Belgium.
